learning_outcomes.text: Ability to access information related to various material types and to conduct source research for this purpose, utilizing databases and other information sources.
Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing.
Gaining the ability to renew oneself by accessing information.
Gaining knowledge about the selection of biomaterials.
Gaining knowledge about the application areas of biomaterials.

syllabus_topics: Definition and classification of the term biomaterial
Polymeric, metallic, ceramic, and composite implant materials
Advantages and disadvantages of using implant materials
bibliography: B.Park, “Biomaterials Science and Engineering”, Plenum Press. New York, 1984.
L.L. Hench and E.C.Ethridge, “Biomaterials”, Acedemic Press, New York, 1982
